sloka: ततो हयं मारुततुल्यवेगमारुह्य शक्तिं निशितां प्रगृह्य।नरान्तको वानरराजसैन्यं महार्णवं मीन इवाविवेश ।। ६.६९.६९ ।।
transliteration: tato hayaṁ mārutatulyavegamāruhya śaktiṁ niśitāṁ pragṛhya।narāntako vānararājasainyaṁ mahārṇavaṁ mīna ivāviveśa ।। 6.69.69 ।।

translations.english: On the way he saw flesh and blood fallen like a heap of a mountain covered fully with Vanaras.
